request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: During the periodic verification of the P&H R200 mobile crane at position 17, must the employer show the results of a supplementary investigation?

response.text: {"kind": "boolean", "value": true, "text": "Yes. The P&H R200 mobile crane at position 17 (autogru, built 1977, matricola 70761) has been in service for more than 20 years. Under DM 11 aprile 2011, Allegato II, point 3.2.3, the employer must show the results of the supplementary investigations (point 2(c)) during periodic verifications of mobile cranes. The IGEA plant sheet asks for the same thing as a structural verification of residual life for equipment over 20 years old.", "sources": [{"file": "DM2011.md", "place": "Allegato II, punto 3.2.3", "quote": "Nel corso delle verifiche periodiche, sulle gru mobili, sulle gru trasferibili e sui ponti sviluppabili su carro ad azionamento motorizzato, sono esibite dal datore di lavoro le risultanze delle indagini supplementari di cui al punto 2, lettera c), effettuate secondo le norme tecniche."}, {"file": "DM2011.md", "place": "Allegato II, punto 2, lettera c)", "quote": "Indagine supplementare: Attivita' finalizzata ad individuare eventuali vizi, difetti o anomalie, prodottisi nell'utilizzo dell'attrezzatura di lavoro messe in esercizio da oltre 20 anni, nonche' a stabilire la vita residua in cui la macchina potra' ancora operare in condizioni di sicurezza con le eventuali relative nuove portate nominali."}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 7, Tabella A4 (pos. 17); p. 5, punto 4.2.2", "quote": "17 AUTOGRU' P&H R200 18760 RM - I - 22027 1977 70761"}]}
